tools.title: Token 粗估计算器
tools.description: 按字符与语言粗估提示词规模，便于排期与预算；不替代官方 tokenizer。
tools.descriptionEn: Rough prompt-size estimates by character and language for planning—not a substitute for an official tokenizer.
tools.purpose: 在写提示词或设计 Agent 上下文窗口时，快速估算输入规模。
tools.purposeEn: Quickly gauge input size when drafting prompts or sizing an agent context window.
scenarios: 设计系统提示词长度上限
对比中英文提示的大致 Token 差
给产品排期一个「上下文预算」参考值
scenariosEn: Set a length budget for system prompts
Compare rough token cost between Chinese and English prompts
Give product planning a context-window reference
